data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'hardos', meaning 'firm, strong, or sturdy'. In Christian tradition, the name Harday is associated with strength, endurance, and resilience. The name Harday carries the meaning “Strong, Hardy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Harday usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, hardy and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Harday holds a significant cultural impact as it is reminiscent of the Biblical character, Hardasatha (or Hartah), a Levite chief who remained steadfast in his faith and led the Israelites during a crucial time in their history. This name carries a powerful message of courage, resolve, and commitment, inspiring those who bear it to be unwavering in their beliefs and actions.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Harday lies in its connection to the Divine attributes of strength and steadfastness. It reminds us of God's faithfulness and encourages us to emulate His qualities. The name Harday can serve as a constant reminder of our calling to stand firm in our faith and remain steadfast in the face of adversity, as we walk the Christian path.
